accessorial_charges.name: residential_delivery
accessorial_charges.condition: Consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential.

accessorial_policy.note: Clause 5 states no other accessorial charges are payable under this agreement beyond residential delivery (clause 4); any other service requires prior written agreement evidenced by a rate confirmation.

ambiguities.description: Clause 1 bands are 'up to and including 500 kg' (<=500) at ₹18.00/km and '501 kg to 2,000 kg' (>=501, <=2000) at ₹24.00/km. A fractional billed weight strictly between 500 and 501 kg (e.g. 500.5 kg) falls in neither band as literally written.

Clause 4's condition covers two distinct triggers ('consignee address is a residence' OR 'booking is flagged residential') but the contract does not specify a shipment data field for either factor separately; the structured trigger here uses special_handling contains 'residential' as the closest single machine-evaluable proxy, which may not fully capture an address-based residential determination distinct from an explicit booking flag.

exclusions.description: Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

notes: Service scope is full and part truckload road carriage, all-India lanes (contract header).
Clause 8 permits the Carrier to issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices, referencing the original consignment note number and the invoice corrected.

pricing_basis.description: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, at a rate that varies by the consignment's billed weight band. An express service premium and a fuel surcharge apply on top where applicable.

surcharges.name: fuel_surcharge
surcharges.condition: Applies to the freight charge, i.e. base freight plus express premium where applicable.
